programme.title: Thomas and the Inventors Workshop
programme.desc: Thomas is asked to help find the inventor, Ruth, a new home and workshop on Sodor.

programme.title: Tulip Fields, Netherlands
programme.desc: Is Glitch stealing tulips from the Netherlands? Thats what the Go Jetters think and they almost ruin the parade Glitch and Tala are making a huge tulip flower float for.

programme.title: Himalayan Heroes, Nepal
programme.desc: Hoping to follow in his great-aunts footsteps, Glitch enlists the help of a sceptical Foz and a friendly yak in order to find a yeti in the Himalayas.

programme.title: Monkey Bay, Thailand
programme.desc: Glitchs plans to open a hotel on an unspoilt beach in Thailand go horribly wrong when a group of macaque monkeys steal his Grim-o-freeze gun.

programme.title: The Clock Tower Heist
programme.desc: Somebody stole the big hand off the clock tower. Mojo and Bo are on the case, but it is not as simple as it seems. Soon, they are pulling off a heist they never expected.

programme.title: Shark n Ride
programme.desc: A shark on the loose in the streets of Swoppiton? Mojo and Bo are on a fishing trip to find out more! But the hungry shark might not be quite as hungry-sharky as they think.

programme.title: Evil Peamobile Goes Rogue
programme.desc: Evil Pea adds a voice control feature to her Evil Peamobile, but when she calls it a nitwit, the car decides to teach her a lesson.

programme.title: Captain Pak Choi Returns
programme.desc: Supertato and Carrot are in a race against Captain Pak Choi to find buried treasure on Shiny Things Island, but they soon realise that it is one big trick by Evil Pea.

programme.title: Its Christmas Time Song
programme.desc: Evil Pea is up to her usual mischief as she turns the Supermarket into a Winter Wonderland!

programme.title: Runner Beans Sporty Song
programme.desc: Get ready, set, dance in the supermarket aisles with Supertato, Runner Bean and the whole Tato Team! Featuring Nitro from Gladiators.

programme.title: Carrot Power Song
programme.desc: Dance along with Carrot, the Tato Teams super cool, brave inventor. This song celebrates all things Carrot power!

programme.title: The Colour Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is painting in his favourite colouring book, and the Squirrels want to join in.

programme.title: The Stick Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels are preparing to have a campfire. Duggee is getting it ready and needs the Squirrels to help find lots of wood for it. He needs small sticks, medium and big sticks... Lots of sticks!

programme.title: The Voice Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels start talking to each other in the wrong voices its clear something has gone awry. But Duggee has his voice badge. He knows what to do!

programme.title: The Island Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels are out doing a bit of sailing. What fun! When Tag starts to feel a little bit seasick Duggee suggests a stop off at the Island for a spot of lunch, but wheres all the food?

programme.title: Mystery Seeds
programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds its time for some gardening!

programme.title: Splash Dash
programme.desc: Duggie chooses a key and his blue digger to dig up a big bone. The chipmunk makes a delivery to the squirrels.

programme.title: Ping Pong Penguins
programme.desc: Whats that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? Its the Penguins playing ping-pong!

programme.title: Stick Together
programme.desc: Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!

programme.title: Ready Or Not
programme.desc: Duggee looks all around, but can he find the Squirrels? Lets play Hide and Seek!

programme.title: Dance Mode
programme.desc: After Dad eats her last chip, Bingo is given three chances to put Mum and Dad in Dance Mode as payback. But the others cant resist taking Bingos turns for her.

programme.title: Hammerbarn
programme.desc: On a trip to Hammerbarn, Bluey and Bingo create their own mini-homes side-by-side in the trolley. But Bluey quickly gets jealous of her neighbour, Bingo.

programme.title: Featherwand
programme.desc: Bluey and Mum are off to Chloes party and Bingo isnt invited. But armed with a magic featherwand that makes things incredibly heavy, Bingo can now stop them leaving the house.

programme.title: Squash
programme.desc: When dad and Uncle Stripe play a game of squash, Bluey and Bingo are in control of their every move, and Bingo proves that big siblings dont always beat little siblings.

programme.title: Andy and the Kamchatka Brown Bears
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to Asia on a global adventure to discover why Kamchatka brown bears are gathering at an active volcano. Along the way, they meet a Siberian flying squirrel.

programme.title: Andy and the Humboldt Penguins
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout blast off on a global adventure to Peru, South America, to uncover the stinky secret of a colony of Humboldt penguins living in the desert. Along the way, Andy encounters some boisterous sea lions and tries a bit of crowd surfing.

programme.title: Three
programme.desc: Laa-Laa has fun counting to three 1, 2, 3 rabbits, 1, 2, 3 flowers and 1, 2, 3 trees! LaaLaa even counts three Teletubbies Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po.

programme.title: T
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say t, and we go on an adventure around the sound. We meet a turtle, shake our tails and see a tiger in a tall tent!

programme.title: Me and My Shadow
programme.desc: When Messy breaks the lighthouse, things get shady. But without a shadow of a doubt, he and his friends save the day!

programme.title: Ice Cream Float
programme.desc: Bettys new ice cream flavour is so light, it makes everybody in town float in the air. How will Mojo and Bo get everyones feet back on the ground? By floating up there with them!

programme.title: Turtle Boy
programme.desc: Bingo finds a toy turtle at the playground and wants to take him home, but Dad says its not the right thing to do.

programme.title: Puppets
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.title: The Cheerleading Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggees cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. Theres a big match ahead...

programme.title: The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: Its a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Mystery Seeds
programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds its time for some gardening!

programme.title: Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Bonneville Salt Flats, USA
programme.desc: The Go Jetters arrive at the Bonneville Salt Flats in Utah, USA - a huge dry lakebed thats perfect for high-speed driving. Lars unveils the Turbo Zoomster, a racecar made for Xuli to break the Go Jet land speed record. Suddenly, Grandmaster Glitch arrives at the wheel of his suped-up dragster. He once lost a race to the current record holder, Ubercorn, and now hes back for a second go.

programme.title: Markets
programme.desc: When Bluey visits the markets with five bucks from the tooth fairy, the options are endless. But as she and Indy look for the perfect purchase, spending it proves hard.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kams empire.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed The Invincible Fist is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Will he kill the father of his lover?

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires or fake ones!.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperors death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: Third Master is a renowned swordsman in the martial arts world, but the constant challenges by other swordsmen compel him to fake his death and pursue a secluded life. This does not prevent others from seeking him out to challenge him however, and he is forced to return to fight his way till the end.

programme.title: Lets Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fianc so as to drive away two women whom he does not like

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sisters death, but is shocked to discover that her fianc, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jins mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charns beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dongs concubine as he knows Dongs adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chus family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the groups drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummers mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Los brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hus house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hus pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: My Name Aint Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bats knife, so they try to use that to hunt the real culprit

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiaos stepmother frames her fianc Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to him. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas pursuit.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Changs. On the Changs farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: Governor Yan is killed and his guard Fan identifies Kou as the assassin by his signature weapon, a dart. Kou is listed as a wanted man when he enters the city, but managed to escape arrest with the help of the innkeepers daughter. At the same time, Fan is attacked by a bandit who pretends to be Kou. What are the secret plots behind these attacks?

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tiens gang is helping them he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: Promising martial artist Chao Chih Hao leaves home to compete in a prestigious tournament after training under a legendary master. However, when a corrupt rival school hires Japanese fighters to cripple him, Chao endures brutal training to master the deadly Iron Fist technique and return for a fierce, bone-crushing battle for justice and glory.

programme.title: 中国文艺 China Showbiz
programme.desc: 为综合性专题文艺栏目以弘扬中华民族传统文化播撒五千年古老文明关注中国与世界重大的文艺活动用精彩的电视文艺作品为海内外华人观众打开一扇精神视窗为目标.

programme.title: 环球综艺秀 Universal Show
programme.desc: 环球综艺秀系中央广播电视总台华语环球节目中心（CCTV-4）为配合高质量发展全新推出的一档大型综艺节目模式，着力搭建一个世界文化文艺互鉴的综艺舞台，立足国际平台，用综艺联结人类命运共同体，用文艺向世界贡献中国智慧，打造一个放眼全球放眼世界的文艺文明互鉴平台 邀请世界各国的优秀艺术家和文艺作品，包含音乐舞蹈杂技魔术达人创新等各种艺术形式，和中国的优秀艺术作品共同演绎，让一个又一个美轮美奂令人惊叹的表演进行同台互鉴交流展演互动，同时利用网络融媒体手段，进行短视频传播，打造一个文化共融平台.

programme.title: 海峡两岸 Across the Strait
programme.desc: 中央电视台唯一的涉台时事新闻评论栏目节目宗旨是跟踪海峡热点，反映两岸民意，节目分为两个版块：第一个是热点扫描，主要报道当日的近期台湾岛内的热点新闻；第二个是热点透视，当日或近期涉台热点深度报道及两岸专家对此事的评论，并对两岸各个层面的交流交往进行跟踪报道.

programme.title: 中国新闻 China News
programme.desc: 中国新闻是以海外华人华侨港澳台同胞留学生驻外使领馆及中资机构人员为目标受众的综合性新闻栏目栏目由国内外要闻中国内地经济和社会新闻对国内外重要新闻事件的分析和评论组成.

programme.desc: 2020年新冠疫情来袭，三位女性在前景不明朗的困境中，各自与朋友和家人找寻出路从家里的难题到感情关系的挣扎，还有工作上的斗争，这三位女性都坚强地在困境中找寻出路.

programme.title: 海关战线 Customs Frontline
programme.desc: 香港海关发现一艘货船藏有大量非法武器，调查更揭露事件与国际冲突势力有关精英调查员深入犯罪组织，逐步揭开香港卷入这场跨国军火行动背后的惊天阴谋.

programme.title: 死尸死时四十四 Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: 这部黑色喜剧始于一具来历不明的尸体被发现在一个住宅单位门前，同层的四家人担心尸体会令居所变成凶宅，使楼价大跌，从而卷入了将尸体运走的大混乱中.

programme.title: 重生 Go for Broke
programme.desc: 利欲熏心的贩毒集团不择手段，导致无数家庭因毒品而支离破碎，其中包括张耀的家庭张耀决定要复仇，于是与缉毒队长安渡连手，计划剿灭毒贩首脑然而，随着复仇计划开展，两人究竟是同仇敌忾，还是各怀鬼胎？.

programme.title: L风暴 L Storm
programme.desc: 廉政公署首席调查主任陆志廉与总督察刘保强分别侦查贪污及洗黑钱案，但苦无线索陆志廉因洗黑钱集团诬陷而被控受贿为表清白，他不惜冒生命危险搜集洗黑钱集团的罪证.

programme.title: 被消失的凶案 A Murder Erased
programme.desc: 警长骆英财被派往调查被埋没八年的尸体发现案随着警长锁定疑犯，一名检控官也参与调查想要找出案件的真相在质问警长之下，检控官更发现他的行为有疑，因他对案件的陈述前后不一，充满疑点...

programme.title: 长江七号 CJ7
programme.desc: 周星驰强势回归的作品，讲述一对父子在垃圾桶里发现可爱外星人后，出现一连串既搞笑又温馨的故事.

programme.title: 悟空传 Wu Kong
programme.desc: 在孙悟空未成为齐天大圣前，天庭蓄意毁掉花果山，图以掌控众生命运，悟空在屠杀中得以残存，决心余生要跟天庭对抗到底悟空在天庭遇到一生不能爱却深深爱上的阿紫和一生最强的宿敌杨戬，各人都不甘命运的摆布，却没想到反抗只会带来更大的浩劫他们所做的一切，究竟是不知天高地厚的轻狂，还是无惧宿命抗战到底的热血！.

programme.title: 命中注定那头鹅 Penguin Girl
programme.desc: 月鹅钟爱阿德利企鹅，也深信真爱该如企鹅伴侣那般纯粹当身穿企鹅装的何德利出现在她眼前时，她不禁思索，这是否就是命运安排的另一半随着两人对未来的憧憬渐生迷惘，他们是否仍能如企鹅般成为忠诚的眷属？.

programme.title: 夺冠 Leap
programme.desc: 2008年北京奥运会，昔日中国女排传奇郎平竟以美国队主教练身份击败中国队，深陷舆论漩涡多年后，当中国女排陷入低谷之际，她毅然回归，执教新一代女排新力军她以铁腕改革打破常规，带领球员们绝地突围，最终在2016年里约奥运上演惊天逆袭，重夺奥运金牌.

programme.title: 合家辣 Chilli Laugh Story
programme.desc: 新冠病毒疫情爆发，令Coba在家工作，成天与家人发生争执Coba决定将母亲的手工辣椒酱变成潮物，企图转移家人视线避免争吵Coba的父母和姑妈一起制作手工辣椒酱，并在社交平台上放售，其后辣椒酱大卖，成绩更令大家喜出望外.

programme.title: S风暴 S Storm
programme.desc: 廉政公署首席调查主任陆志廉在调查非法足球搏彩集团时目击嫌疑犯被杀重案组督察刘保强急需陆志廉的口供，但因廉署的保密守则，陆志廉无法提供任何线索，阻碍刘保强的调查二人由调查开始时的互不信任，到最后发展出默契，誓要将犯罪集团连根拔起.

programme.title: 出走的决心 Like A Rolling Stone
programme.desc: 中国式好妈妈李红半生任劳任怨，在日复一日的家务与丈夫的冷漠中感到窒息一场高中同学会意外点燃了她被埋没的青春梦想，她决定打破沉重的家庭枷锁，向妻子与母亲的身份辞职李红毅然驾车出走，独自踏上重启人生的漫漫旅程，在广阔天地间寻回那个遗失已久的自我.

programme.title: OMG! 阿妈有喜 OMG! Moms Big News
programme.desc: 53岁的Rita和丈夫计划退休，却意外怀孕，打乱了原本平静的家庭生活面对这突如其来的新生命，一场安胎之战带来连串笑料与混乱，让一家人重拾理解与包容正当一切看似平静，Rita得知胎儿疑似患有唐氏综合症，她将面临人生最艰难抉择.

programme.title: 大奉打更人 Guardians of the Dafeng
programme.desc: 现代打工人杨凌意外进入到充满玄幻色彩的大奉王朝，并且改头换面成为一名监察百官为大奉百姓破案的打更人 - 许七安他凭借现代所学所能，运用科学知识和推理特长，成功破获一桩桩离奇案件，被誉为大奉断案高手而在这个有妖有法术，人心诡谲，暗流涌动的大奉世界里，他与志同道合的伙伴们，选择迎难而上，敢于舍己牺牲，共同对抗朝廷暗黑势力，为百姓和公道发声，齐心守护大奉安定Office worker Yang Ling unexpectedly enters the fantasy-filled Da Feng Dynasty and takes on a new identity as Xu Qi An, a night watchman responsible for supervising officials and solving cases for the people of Da Feng

programme.title: 下饭江湖第三季 The Soul of a Meal S3
programme.desc: 下饭江湖 第三季通过食物讲述与之间紧密相连的人的故事，这群普通人活出了价值尊严自信，让观众从中获得些许勇气，同时有一种共鸣，就是每一个人都要为之奋斗的精神希望通过节目把这种平凡人的奋斗精神以及人间值得的烟火气传递给更多还在寻找生活真谛的人们.

programme.title: 翘楚 Ashes to Crown
programme.desc: 将军之女楚朝为改变自己成为楚国世子萧珣夺权路上牺牲品的可悲命运，发现主动出击才是改变命运的唯一途径在与命运一波三折的对抗中，她与谢家庶子谢燕来相识，并点亮了谢燕来原本灰暗的人生，助谢燕来挣脱命运枷锁，从禁军小卒成长为镇国大将军楚朝与谢燕来合力成功阻止了世子的野心和计划，在本该逃离是非之地的途中，见到战火中百姓的苦难，楚朝毅然返回城内，助力小皇孙萧羽为帝，直至萧羽亲政然而萧珣又引外敌来犯，为权欲不惜陷万民于水火楚朝携手谢燕来与之殊死抵抗，领军浴血奋战，终于成功解除大楚内忧外患至此，楚朝不仅改变了自己的命运，也让大楚千千万万百姓摆脱了战火离乱的颠沛命运Reborn before her fateful marriage, Generals daughter Chu Chao vows to avert her familys tragic doom. programme.title: 型男大主厨 Stylish Man

programme.title: 與君渡長歡 短劇 Eternal Joy With YouMini drama
programme.desc: 藥商之女許婉寧前世遭丈夫背叛親生骨肉被害，含恨重生；為了守護孩子並復仇，她與調查禁藥的金鱗衛大督主裴珩結盟，兩人從互有成見的試探，到相知相許的聯手，不僅粉碎了危害朝政的驚天陰謀，更在夢境與現實的交錯中，讓女主重獲自救的勇氣，開啟了全新人生.

programme.title: 黑月光法則短劇 Princess RevengeMini drama
programme.desc: 名門千金東方曦為愛隱姓埋名打工供養男友，慘遭背叛後覺醒，竟發現自己身處小說世界，成了注定悲劇的惡毒女配；為了改寫命運，她與系統達成賭約，不僅當眾揭穿了渣男的真面目，更發現暗中守護自己的大哥竟是系統化身這是一場關於覺醒反殺與破局的奇幻愛戀，挑戰傳統的黑月光法則.

programme.title: 啟航！大運河 Go! Grand Canal
programme.desc: 將通過十個主題，圍繞歷史政治文化經濟等多重視角，清晰勾勒大運河從起源到發展的脈絡，挖掘這個世界文化遺產蘊藏的精神價值和人文內涵，展現其在中華民族歷史文化中的特殊地位與突出貢獻，助力古老大運河煥發時代新風貌.

programme.title: 盒子裡的貓 Mystery In The Box

programme.title: 大内密探零零发 Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: 零零恭零零喜零零发零零财四个人，是负责保卫北宋皇帝（张达明饰）安全的保龙一族恭喜财三人虽然武功高强，然而，零零发（周星驰饰）由于不懂武功，只会搞些小发明，始终不被皇上重用，只可伪装成妇科大夫给人看病，随时等皇帝的候命后来，金国无相王以解剖研究天外飞仙（外星人）尸体为名，欲把中土所有大夫引出，令中土军队无人医理，金国可易于南下无意间，竟骗出皇帝，并将三大高手歼灭关键时刻零零发使用他发明的直升机和机关枪救出皇帝，并把无相王妻子及儿子杀掉零零发护主有功，回国后受皇帝信任，并获得重赏受皇帝宠信的发，获皇帝安排到城中有名妓院慧研雅叙了解金国名妓琴操，琴操的美丽令发想起皇上尾注原来，琴操是无相王所化身，图破坏其家庭和皇帝的信任，陷发之不义，以为妻儿报仇实际上，零零发早看穿其阴谋，并使出天外飞仙一招将无相王击败.

programme.desc: 第9集 n金谷命鸣凤设法赶桂思离开平安谷；鸣凤找到桂思伪造政府专员证物，金谷命人将水丰和桂思分别收监水丰想起桂思疑似有孕，命水雄救桂思金谷准许桂思留在家中安胎北杏自死过翻生后，很想知道东阳怎样看待她东阳表示感谢北杏照顾淼淼，北杏因而释怀金谷吩咐鸣凤向村民提早收田租买补品给桂思，桂思不想自己怀孕伤害村民，决定离开平安谷初一向桂思透露树根嫂变得疯癫，是因其兄娶妻前失足跌落河淹死，桂思答应设法让她们母子在一起乌公公找金谷替他找个知书识礼的女子结婚，又送金谷医治痔疮的秘方.

programme.title: 平安谷之诡谷传说 Forgotten Valley, The
programme.desc: 第10集n金谷痔疮发作正要涂药之际，水丰来认错，又劝他跟乌公公一刀了断，金谷拒绝鸣凤借意教导桂思孝顺金谷，桂思领会桂思向金谷请罪，且要送他一份大礼鸣凤看见曼仪拿着食物盒和雨伞离家；鸣凤找不到曼仪，意外见到天佑，天佑强吻她时被曼仪目睹天佑来找水丰和桂思，金谷命鸣凤招呼天佑水丰带金谷和天佑来到山洞堪察，天佑认为要用鼓风炉提炼才确定山洞的含金量，要花一万几千大洋，金谷提议找乌公公资助乌公公拿出大清十二位皇帝都戴过的玉佩，以五百大洋卖给金谷水丰怀疑玉佩价值，决定到快活谷调查乌公公的身世.

programme.title: 金宵大厦 Barrack OKarma
programme.desc: 萧伟明陈山聪饰来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex 李施嬅饰容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO李施嬅分饰，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉陈山聪分饰，奇梦还被书店主人林若思张彦博饰写成小说阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘.

programme.title: 洪武三十二 Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆陈山聪，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风谢天华奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣马德钟的得力谋臣马三保陈键锋，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱江若琳却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三徐子珊和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中.

programme.title: 情逆三世缘 Always And Ever
programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲 Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎钱嘉乐受不了母亲刘并蒂黄淑仪不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾陈键锋抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英胡定欣的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘苏玉华制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为王老虎抢亲谱出崭新局面.

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人 My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏宣萱旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤唐诗咏作为她的头号助手，唯命是从任劳任怨，更练出伪撒娇本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深林文龙与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号上海撒破郎的美女实习生田蜜高海宁接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超黎诺懿北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖王浩信，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？.

programme.title: 食为奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天宝王祖蓝自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫胡诺言流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪万绮雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女厨神米小鱼何雁诗等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛黄智贤，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭林盛斌，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩张继聪策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗.

programme.title: 坚离地爱坚离地 Offliners, The
programme.desc: 在香港，投身金融地产商业是贴地举动，富二代王子菲龚嘉欣饰却偏爱离地，与好友许正伟陈智燊饰开设初创科技公司一次网络黑客事件让子菲见识到IT奇才丁信希张振朗饰的厉害，邀他加入公司信希是一名离地毒男，不顾世事，得护士张莱刘佩玥饰帮助走出不善沟通的围墙，对她好感渐生；子菲与信希经历分歧，至同心及互补不足，不经意对他产生情愫子菲本相信科技为世界带来美好，但网络风波相继发生在其父王守勤李国麟饰弟王梓龙罗梓龙饰信希之妹丁信恩黄心颖饰身上！.

programme.title: 溏心风暴3 Heart And Greed
programme.desc: 凌丽荧李司棋与丈夫黄永正夏雨凭着努力从茶餐厅发展成为结合地产业务的集团，丽荧弟弟凌乘风黄宗泽更协助他们上市，永正本不欲上市，但因当年许雅麟李国麟助他脱罪之恩，一直耿耿于怀，有见许家经营印刷的百年基业面临倒闭危机，便听从乘风献计，可透过合并令两家相得益彰，但永正的弟妇梁顺华关菊英及亲弟梁赞阮兆祥大力反对，加上与雅麟的太太余秀慧米雪有积怨，对许家自诩上等人印象欠佳，但丽荧力撑丈夫终达成合并协议可惜合并后引发两家一连串的祸端，草根与富豪阶级悬殊激发矛盾丛生，加上二儿子黄围家王浩信与许家独生女许贝儿岑丽香相爱备受阻挠，最终逼使围家远离伤心地，丽荧心痛不已又承受长女黄以爱陈敏之与有妇之夫郑立安唐文龙的丑闻煎熬；就连至疼锡的乘风亦性情大变，与好友方希文黄翠如关系纠缠不清，两家陷入分拆决裂之余更面临一场酝酿已久的复仇风暴.

programme.title: 醋娘子 Lady Sour
programme.desc: 曹青胡杏儿与母亲曹曹闭月黄淑仪结伴行医跑江湖，先后认识了患皮肤病的计准吴卓羲和同乡钱通罗仲谦，曹青对钱通一见钟情，千方百计嫁入钱家，可惜醋坊当家钱霜陈炜因与闭月有积怨对曹青百般阻挠，计准因病治愈献计助曹青得偿所愿，曹青入门后以为一劳永逸，谁料钱通深爱丫环山楂岑丽香，曹青乘机搞乱，反令山楂和钱通意外发生关系，钱通纳山楂为妾，令曹青醋意大发，火上加油突然，一具尸骸被发现，闭月被告谋害亲夫判处死刑，钱家怕名声受损，要求曹青与闭月断绝母女关系，此际，曹青竟发现有喜，却惹来一场休妻大行动.

programme.title: 醋娘子 Lady Sour

programme.title: 食为奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天宝王祖蓝自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫胡诺言流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪万绮雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女厨神米小鱼何雁诗等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛黄智贤，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭林盛斌，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩张继聪策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗.

programme.title: 坚离地爱坚离地 Offliners, The
programme.desc: 在香港，投身金融地产商业是贴地举动，富二代王子菲龚嘉欣饰却偏爱离地，与好友许正伟陈智燊饰开设初创科技公司一次网络黑客事件让子菲见识到IT奇才丁信希张振朗饰的厉害，邀他加入公司信希是一名离地毒男，不顾世事，得护士张莱刘佩玥饰帮助走出不善沟通的围墙，对她好感渐生；子菲与信希经历分歧，至同心及互补不足，不经意对他产生情愫子菲本相信科技为世界带来美好，但网络风波相继发生在其父王守勤李国麟饰弟王梓龙罗梓龙饰信希之妹丁信恩黄心颖饰身上！.

programme.title: 溏心风暴3 Heart And Greed
programme.desc: 凌丽荧李司棋与丈夫黄永正夏雨凭着努力从茶餐厅发展成为结合地产业务的集团，丽荧弟弟凌乘风黄宗泽更协助他们上市，永正本不欲上市，但因当年许雅麟李国麟助他脱罪之恩，一直耿耿于怀，有见许家经营印刷的百年基业面临倒闭危机，便听从乘风献计，可透过合并令两家相得益彰，但永正的弟妇梁顺华关菊英及亲弟梁赞阮兆祥大力反对，加上与雅麟的太太余秀慧米雪有积怨，对许家自诩上等人印象欠佳，但丽荧力撑丈夫终达成合并协议可惜合并后引发两家一连串的祸端，草根与富豪阶级悬殊激发矛盾丛生，加上二儿子黄围家王浩信与许家独生女许贝儿岑丽香相爱备受阻挠，最终逼使围家远离伤心地，丽荧心痛不已又承受长女黄以爱陈敏之与有妇之夫郑立安唐文龙的丑闻煎熬；就连至疼锡的乘风亦性情大变，与好友方希文黄翠如关系纠缠不清，两家陷入分拆决裂之余更面临一场酝酿已久的复仇风暴.

programme.title: 醋娘子 Lady Sour
programme.desc: 曹青胡杏儿与母亲曹曹闭月黄淑仪结伴行医跑江湖，先后认识了患皮肤病的计准吴卓羲和同乡钱通罗仲谦，曹青对钱通一见钟情，千方百计嫁入钱家，可惜醋坊当家钱霜陈炜因与闭月有积怨对曹青百般阻挠，计准因病治愈献计助曹青得偿所愿，曹青入门后以为一劳永逸，谁料钱通深爱丫环山楂岑丽香，曹青乘机搞乱，反令山楂和钱通意外发生关系，钱通纳山楂为妾，令曹青醋意大发，火上加油突然，一具尸骸被发现，闭月被告谋害亲夫判处死刑，钱家怕名声受损，要求曹青与闭月断绝母女关系，此际，曹青竟发现有喜，却惹来一场休妻大行动.

programme.title: 食为奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天宝王祖蓝自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫胡诺言流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪万绮雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女厨神米小鱼何雁诗等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛黄智贤，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭林盛斌，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩张继聪策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗.

programme.title: 坚离地爱坚离地 Offliners, The
programme.desc: 在香港，投身金融地产商业是贴地举动，富二代王子菲龚嘉欣饰却偏爱离地，与好友许正伟陈智燊饰开设初创科技公司一次网络黑客事件让子菲见识到IT奇才丁信希张振朗饰的厉害，邀他加入公司信希是一名离地毒男，不顾世事，得护士张莱刘佩玥饰帮助走出不善沟通的围墙，对她好感渐生；子菲与信希经历分歧，至同心及互补不足，不经意对他产生情愫子菲本相信科技为世界带来美好，但网络风波相继发生在其父王守勤李国麟饰弟王梓龙罗梓龙饰信希之妹丁信恩黄心颖饰身上！.

Lutfiya mendapat tawaran untuk bekerja di Australia. Syed Fuad membuat tawaran kepada Lutfiya supaya bekerja di syarikatnya dan dia sanggup menawarkan gaji dua kali ganda dari yang diterima oleh Lutfiya dengan syarat Lutfiya berkahwin dengan Raziq!

Rahsia tentang identitinya juga terancam dan dia mendapati dirinya berlumba dengan masa dan hati yang remuk. Sofia juga menemui satu rahsia keluarga yang terpendam menyebabkan dia terkejut

programme.title: Black S2
programme.desc: Black bertekad untuk menuntut keadilan ke atas nyawa yang hilang dan dihancurkan oleh penjenayah yang masih berleluasa.

programme.desc: Sekumpulan remaja menceroboh masuk ke sebuah taman tema yang telah lama ditinggalkan. Berlatarbelakangkan zaman sebelum tersebarnya kisah-kisah seram dari kes Highland Tower, kumpulan ini percaya bahawa hantu tidak wujud. Lalu mereka mencabar satu sama lain untuk bermain permainan roh duit syiling di dalam taman tema terbiar itu.

programme.desc: Selepas menumpaskan rangkaian dadah dan kemudian membunuh ketua geng. Seorang polis mula syak seorang rakan sekerja kanan terlibat dalam penyeludupan dadah dengan orang Amerika. Dia mula mengumpul bukti tanpa sedar bahawa rasuah itu berakar umbi.

programme.title: Abang Long Fadil 1
programme.desc: Abang Long Fadil, seorang lelaki yang sentiasa berangan bahawa kehidupannya seperti seorang gangster. Tetapi apabila sahabat baiknya, Malik dimasukkan ke penjara, lebih banyak kekacauan berlaku dan angan-angannya mungkin tidak jauh berbeza daripada realiti.

programme.title: Golden Job
programme.desc: Sekumpulan bekas tentera upahan bersatu semula untuk merancang rompakan epik: meningkatkan trak penuh ubat yang dipegang oleh agensi perisikan asing untuk membekalkan kem pelarian yang memerlukan. Tetapi apabila mereka mendapati trak itu benar-benar dipenuhi dengan emas yang dicuri, kumpulan saudara-saudara itu menyedari bahawa mereka telah diserang dua kali oleh salah seorang daripada mereka sendiri - dan meletakkan keadaan yang betul akan menjadi perang habis-habisan.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP8
programme.desc: Imbas kembali beberapa tahun lalu semasa Lisa, Sara dan Afifa tinggal bersama Mbah Nira. Namun Sara mati, bagaimanapun Mbah Nira menggunakan ilmu hitamnya menjadikan Sara sebagai Saka. Mbah Nira menurunkan ilmu hitamnya kepada Lisa dan Afifa. Kali ini, Cairyl dan Azhar bertindak menculik Afifa dan Lisa, mereka mendesak Lisa dan Afifa supaya mengarahkan Mbah Nira membebaskan Bakri daripada terus disihirkan. Tiba-tiba muncul Saka Sara menyebabkan Cairyl dan Azhar melarikan diri. Lisa dan Afifa balik ke rumah Mbah Nira, diketahui ilmu hitam yang dimiliki oleh Lisa lebih kuat berbanding Afifa. Bakri akhirnya meninggal. Nasrun merayu pertolongan Syamil, meminta Mbah Nira melepaskannya daripada disihirkan. Lisa bertindak menggunakan Saka Sara ke atas Azhar dan Cairyl.

programme.title: The Equalizer S3 EP16
programme.desc: Apabila Aunty Vi merupakan satu-satunya juri dalam perbicaraan pembunuhan yang percaya bahawa defendan tidak bersalah, McCall secara rahsia menyiasat kes itu untuk mencari bukti bahawa naluri Vi adalah betul.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP9
programme.desc: Zacky selamat setelah dirawat oleh Dr Zakir dan Dr Flora. Sementara itu Alia mula terganggu dengan Zacky dan orang-orang yang memanggil namanya Affi. Ritz masih tetap merahsiakan idenditi Alia kerana bimbang dia disakiti. Alia mula meragui idenditinya lalu bertindak untuk menyiasat. Dalam situasi berasingan, sepasukan polis giat menyiasat kes-kes lama berkaitan kehilangan dan kematian wanita yang tidak dapat dikesan. Amir menjadi suspek utama mereka

programme.title: Kamu Tidak Sendiri
programme.desc: Satu malam di pejabat bertukar menjadi mimpi ngeri apabila seorang wanita terperangkap dalam lif selepas gempa bumi besar.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP4
programme.desc: Kumpulan Hunter berjaya menangkap Siti semula, lalu merogolnya. Syamil menunjukkan gambar Nasrun kepadanya Lisa, dia memberitahu Afifa yang dia syak Nasrun dan rakan-rakannya adalah perogol mereka 7 tahun lalu. Afifa menggunakan ilmu hitamnya ke atas Nasrun, namun Mbah Ngai merampas peralatan tersebut. Imbas kembali 7 tahun lalu, Afifa, Sara dan Lisa diserang Kumpulan Hunter yang bertopeng, mereka menculik dan merogol mereka. Lisa keluar bersama Afifa ke rumah kosong lokasi mereka pernah di rogol. Tiba-tiba mereka ternampak Siti terbaring keseorangan. Pada tangan Siti terdapat segumpal rambut perogolnya. Mereka membawa Siti balik untuk berjumpa dengan Pak Samad yang kebetulan baru sampai. Lisa ternampak seutas jam di bilik Siti, kebetulan jam yang sama pernah di terima oleh Lisa satu masa lalu. Manakala Afifa menggunakan sihir ke atas pemilik rambut yang diambil dari tangan Siti. Bakri tiba-tiba muntah darah semasa meraikan kejayaan mereka bersama Caryl dan Azhar

programme.title: Petualangan Anak Penangkap Hantu
programme.desc: Pengembaraan sekumpulan kanak-kanak yang suka menangkap hantu. Mereka ialah Rafi, Zidan dan Chacha. Seperti Pemburu Hantu sebenar, mereka mempunyai alat yang boleh membantu mereka menyiapkan misi menangkap.

programme.title: Minyak Dagu
programme.desc: Minyak Dagu mengisahkan tentang Azman yang berdendam dengan bekas tunangnya Emelda dan disebabkan terlalu dendam dan mengikut pujukan daripada kawannya, Azman telah berjumpa bomoh, Wak Minarjo seorang pawang hebat minyak dagu. Emelda yang memutuskan pertunangan dengan Azman demi mengikut cakap kedua-dua orang tuanya bahawa Johan adalah seorang calon suami yang baik dan boleh menjamin masa depan Emelda, nak dibandingkan Azman yang hanya seorang jurujual yang sering tak ada untungnya.

programme.title: Kongsi
programme.desc: Kongsi merupakan sebuah filem aksi komedi mengisahkan penyiasatan ASP Shariff Fizo Omar terhadap kes pembunuhan dikalangan kumpulan kongsi gelap di Kuala Lumpur. Kumpulan kongsi gelap yang terdiri dari tiga kaum utama Melayu, Cina dan India ini menjadi huru hara dengan kematian seorang demi seorang ahlinya. Pergaduhan besar hampir berlaku kerana mereka saling tuduh menuduh antara satu sama lain apabila berlaku pembunuhan.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP9
programme.desc: Mak Timah dan Cikgu Zaiton masih tidak berpuas hati dengan Cikgu Siti yang dikatakan memiliki ilmu hitam. Perkara ini dihebohkan menyebabkan orang kampung mulai menjauhkan diri dari Cikgu Siti. Farhan menegur perbuatan Cikgu Zaiton kerana membuat fitnah kepada Cikgu Siti. Farhan masih cuba berbaik-baik dengan Cikgu Siti, bagaimanapun Cikgu Siti cuba menjauhkan diri dari Farhan kerana telah diberi amaran oleh Mak Timah.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP10
programme.desc: Nurin berjumpa dengan Yeh Kumbang kerana ingin meminta pertolongan untuk mendapatkan rumah baru bagi mereka. Cikgu Zaiton ternampak mereka, dia membawa orang kampung untuk menangkap khalwat pasangan tersebut. Tiba-tiba muncul Wan Peah yang membuat mereka semua melarikan diri. Farhan memarahi Cikgu Zaiton kerana membuat fitnah. Cikgu Siti berterusan memarahi adiknya Nurin, dia tidak membenarkan Nurin berjumpa dengan Yeh Kumbang.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP11
programme.desc: Cikgu Zaiton pengsan selepas ternampak lembaga seakan-akan Wan Peah di hadapan rumah Cikgu Siti semasa pulang dari kedai. Tok Hashim kemudiannya mengadakan sembahyang hajat dan doa selamat. Mak Timah dan Cikgu Zaiton tidak habis-habis menyalahkan Cikgu Siti yang kononnya memakai menyebabkan huru-hara di kampung mereka. Selepas solat hajat, Nurin yang merasa bersalah mengaku dialah yang menakut-nakutkan Cikgu Zaiton pada malam tersebut. Farhan semasa berkelah dengan Cikgu Siti dan 3 sahabatnya di Bukit Berapit mendapati Aishah tiba-tiba hilang.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP12
programme.desc: Ramli dan isterinya Mariam ke rumah Wan Peah untuk mengambil emaknya. Farhan, Cikgu Siti dan 3 sahabat kemudiannya masuk ke rumah Wan Peah, Mereka ternampak gambar Tok Hashim bersama-sama Wan Peah semasa muda. Malangnya Mak Timah muncul dan mengarahkan Farhan balik ke rumah. Sebenarnya Tok Hashim mempunyai hubungan cinta dengan Wan Peah 30 tahun lalu. Perkahwinannya dengan Mak Timah kerana terpaksa.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP10
programme.desc: Polis mengatur rancangan untuk memerangkap Amir. Tan Seri Jamaludin hilang sabar kerana Uda masih gagal mendapatkan tanda tangan Zacky. Dia memberhentikan semua kemudahan kewangan Zacky serta mengupah orang melanggar Uda. Sementara itu Zacky berjaya memikat Alia dan sempat menyampaikan hasrat untuk memilikinya. Alia mula terasa pernah melalui hidup bersama Zacky. Emosi dan fikirannya Alia semakin terganggau dan keliru sehingga mengalamai depresi. Sophie pula tidak sabar memiliki Zacky untuk mengaut harta. Rafeeq mengarah orang-orang untuk terus menjejaki Zacky dan Alia

programme.title: Agrotech Heroes

programme.title: Aroma Malaysia

programme.title: The Human Odyssey
programme.desc: Dokumentari ini menelusuri kisah asal usul dan pengembaraan manusia sejagat dalam memahami siapa kita dan dari mana kita datang melalui lakonan semula dan rekaan visual yang menarik.

programme.title: Headgear Hunting
programme.desc: Dr Welyne Jehom, an anthropologist, search for expert traditional headgear makers in order to deepen her own knowledge of the craft and preserve the tradition for the benefit of future generations.

programme.title: Journey of The Bidayuh
programme.desc: James Ritchie will take us to discover more about the Bidayuh. A documentary series that will touch on the aspects of Bidayuh culture, tradition, history and where this race fares in todays world.

programme.title: Aroma Puncak Borneo
programme.desc: Catatan perjalanan seorang nomad, eksplorasi masakan dan makanan unik etnik di pergunungan tanah tinggi, selain menemukan pengalaman baharu mengenai adat, budaya dan tradisi..

programme.title: My Body, My Life!
programme.desc: My Body, My Life! is a TV series tackling obesity-related diseases, offering expert insights, real-life stories, and practical health strategies to empower Sarawaks community for a healthier future.

programme.title: Hilang
programme.desc: The murder of an undocumented teenager in the small town of Seri Daik brings Inspector Munir back to the birthplace he left 17 years ago. He runs into Yusof, a religious scholar whom Munir blames for the death of his sister during a failed exorcism.

programme.title: L TVS Pagi
programme.desc: TVS Pagi membawakan perkembangan menyeluruh dari dalam dan luar negara.

programme.title: Kasih Seorang Ayah
programme.desc: Husin yang baru memulakan pekerjaan baharu dikejutkan oleh panggilan isterinya, Aminahayahnya, Pak Yusof, tidak pulang sejak keluar pagi tadi. Setelah mencari ke merata tempat, Husin akhirnya menemui Pak Yusof di sebuah perhentian bas dalam keadaan keliru dan ketakutan. Pak Yusof tidak ingat jalan pulang, malah tidak tahu di mana dia berada. Hairan dengan perubahan sikap ayahnya, Husin membawa beliau ke klinik. Di situlah mereka menerima berita yang mengejutkan: Pak Yusof menghidap Alzheimer. Dari saat itu, bermulalah perjalanan penuh cabaran buat Husin dan keluarganya dalam menjaga insan yang mereka sayangi.

programme.title: Jika Fattah
programme.desc: Kehadiran Fattah yang merupakan seorang anak yatim di dalam keluarga Zaidi telah mengubah kehidupan mereka sekeluarga melalui sikap terpuji yang ada di dalam diri Fattah yang menyedarkan Zaidi dan isterinya Intan.

programme.title: Salina
programme.desc: Salina tinggal di sebuah banglo cantik yang mempunyai sejarah misteri. Apabila kejadian aneh dan menakutkan mula berlaku, terutamanya terhadap anak-anaknya, Salina mula menyiasat sejarah banglo itu untuk melindungi mereka. Namun, keadaan menjadi semakin teruk sehingga membawa kepada kematian yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: Taikun
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua lelaki bernama Tai dan Kun, sahabat baik yang hanya meminati pergaduhan dan mencuri. Apabila tabiat buruk mereka menyebabkan mereka bertembung dan memukul teruk ahli geng Pink dan Purple, Tai dan Kun kemudian direkrut oleh ketua geng yang kagum dengan kemahiran mereka.

programme.title: Ruang Temu

programme.title: Olimpias Way
programme.desc: Seorang penyanyi pop berusia 70 tahun yang pernah menjadi legenda muzik memulakan satu perjalanan merentasi tempat-tempat yang pernah menaikkan namanya. Dia menyewa seorang gadis muda yang pemalu sebagai pemandu, dan bersama-sama mereka melalui perjalanan emosi yang penuh kenangan, perubahan diri, dan hubungan antara dua generasi. Sepanjang perjalanan itu, mereka mula memahami erti kehidupan, kehilangan, dan kebebasan untuk memilih jalan sendiri.

Pertemuan itu mengubah hidup Jimmy dan mencetuskan pelbagai kejadian lucu serta romantik antara manusia dan duyung.

programme.desc: Pada 2018, Aman berpindah dari Pahang ke Kuala Lumpur mengejar impian menjadi penulis, namun hidupnya penuh kesusahandihalau dari bilik sewa, terpaksa tidur di kereta, dan menjadi pemandu e-hailing secara haram kerana buta warna. Hidupnya berubah apabila bertemu Bella, seorang penumpang yang menawarkan tempat tinggal dengan syarat Aman menjadi pemandu peribadinya. Persahabatan terjalin, tetapi konflik menanti. Bagaimana nasib kedua-dua jiwa miskin bandar ini akan terungkai?

Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.

programme.title: Di Balik Perangkap Kematian Yang Menghantuiku
programme.desc: Nada Masaji Wijayanto meninggalkan rumah, dan Melody Larasati Nugroho merasa keliru tentang apa yang harus dilakukan untuk menyelamatkan rumah tangganya. Melody kemudian pergi berjumpa bomoh. Tanpa ragu, Melody meminta agar dia dapat menukar Nada dengan seseorang yang lebih baik dan juga ingin kembali ke masa lalu. Walaupun kesal, bomoh tersebut akhirnya menuruti permintaan Melody dan mula membaca mantera, sehingga Melody terperangkap dalam portal waktu dan dibawa ke masa lalu.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: Cinta Setelah Cinta
programme.desc: Starla menyangka dia telah menghadapi segalanya, tetapi penipuan Niko jauh lebih mendalam daripada yang disangkanya. Ketika dia terus berusaha mempertahankan perkahwinannya, ancaman baharu muncul. Ayu, yang masih taksub dengan Niko, semakin mengikatnya dalam perangkap dengan menggunakan anak mereka yang belum lahir sebagai umpan. Pada masa yang sama, naluri Starla merasakan ada sesuatu yang tidak kena, dan dia mula diburu oleh bayang-bayang serta rahsia gelap. Dengan keluarganya di ambang bahaya dan emosinya semakin tertekan, adakah Starla mampu melindungi orang-orang tersayang? Atau adakah pengkhianatan Niko akan mendorongnya melangkaui batas yang tidak boleh kembali?

Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.

programme.title: Job Paling The B35T Adalah Mencintaimu
programme.desc: Demi membantu menyara keluarganya, Dinda sanggup melakukan pelbagai pekerjaan. Akhirnya, dia menemui kerjaya yang sesuai sebagai perancang perkahwinan. Namun, Dinda terpaksa berganding bahu dengan Zidan, lelaki yang pernah bertelagah dengannya. Daripada sering bercanggah pendapat, hubungan mereka mula berubah apabila bekerjasama menguruskan pelbagai majlis perkahwinan.

programme.title: Musuh Tapi Jadian
programme.desc: Bara Lucky Perdana, seorang jurulatih panjat tebing, berdepan risiko kehilangan pekerjaannya jika gagal melahirkan atlet yang mampu menjuarai kejohanan kebangsaan. Tanpa diduga, dia menemui Raya Angelica Simperler, seorang penghantar barangan yang memiliki bakat luar biasa dalam sukan panjat tebing. Walaupun sering bertelagah, Bara tetap berusaha memujuk Raya untuk menjadi atlet bimbingannya, dan hubungan mereka perlahan-lahan berubah daripada permusuhan kepada bibit-bibit cinta.

programme.title: Salingka Bumi Minang
programme.desc: Dokumentari separa realiti yang meneroka Minang, sebuah wilayah di Indonesia yang terkenal sebagai Tanah Para Pedagang.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: Cinta Setelah Cinta
programme.desc: Starla menyangka dia telah menghadapi segalanya, tetapi penipuan Niko jauh lebih mendalam daripada yang disangkanya. Ketika dia terus berusaha mempertahankan perkahwinannya, ancaman baharu muncul. Ayu, yang masih taksub dengan Niko, semakin mengikatnya dalam perangkap dengan menggunakan anak mereka yang belum lahir sebagai umpan. Pada masa yang sama, naluri Starla merasakan ada sesuatu yang tidak kena, dan dia mula diburu oleh bayang-bayang serta rahsia gelap. Dengan keluarganya di ambang bahaya dan emosinya semakin tertekan, adakah Starla mampu melindungi orang-orang tersayang? Atau adakah pengkhianatan Niko akan mendorongnya melangkaui batas yang tidak boleh kembali?

Hingga suatu hari, Resti bertemu dengan seorang lelaki kaya bernama Verdi dan mereka akhirnya menikah. Nara sangat gembira kerana perkahwinan Resti membawa kehidupan yang lebih baik untuk mereka, tetapi kegembiraan Nara berakhir seketika apabila dia menemui sesuatu yang menggoncangkan dunianya dan mengancam untuk memisahkan keluarganya.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: Lingling Gong, Lingling Xi, Lingling Fa, and Lingling Cai were the Dragon Protectors, responsible for protecting the Northern Song emperor. While Gong, Xi, and Cai were highly skilled in martial arts, Lingling Fa, lacking martial arts knowledge and only capable of tinkering with inventions, was never truly valued by the emperor and was relegated to posing as a gynecologist, awaiting the emperors orders. Later, the Jin dynastys Faceless King, under the guise of dissecting the corpses of celestial beings aliens, attempted to lure all the doctors out of the Central Plains, leaving the army without medical care and facilitating the Jins southward advance. Unwittingly, they tricked the emperor and annihilated the three masters. At the critical moment, Lingling Fa used his inventionsa helicopter and a machine gunto rescue the emperor and kill the Faceless Kings wife and son. For his meritorious service in protecting his master, Lingling Fa returned home to gain the emperors trust and receive a substantial reward. Fa, favored by the emperor, was arranged by the emperor to visit the famous brothel Huiyan Yaxu in the city to learn about Qin Cao, a renowned courtesan of the Jin Dynasty. Qin Caos beauty reminded Fa of The Emperors Last Note. It turned out that Qin Cao was actually the incarnation of The King Without Form, plotting to destroy Fas family and the emperors trust, frame Fa for injustice, and avenge his wife and children. In reality, Fa had already seen through her scheme and defeated The King Without Form with his Flying Immortal from Beyond the Heavens technique.

To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. The contestants will don elegant Hanfu traditional Han Chinese clothing and showcase their beauty at the Nanyue Temple Fairs folk-themed food and culture street they will then participate in a parade at the famous landmark 1944 Town in cheongsams after returning to their guesthouse for a short rest, they will prepare to wear swimsuits for a QA session. Many more attractions await the contestants in Changsha and Hengyang, where they will learn Hunan embroidery techniques from instructors and a thrilling whitewater rafting experience is also on the itinerary.

programme.title: Star Weekly
programme.desc: The talk show Star Weekly invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! With so much surrounding information, the show features a special Fact Check segment, where guests personally respond to various rumors, allowing the parties involved to clarify the truth!

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Finance Magazine 2026
programme.desc: Financial Insights keeps a close watch on the market, reviewing weekly trends in Hong Kong stocks and paying attention to the real estate sector. Through exclusive interviews with industry professionals and market analysis, the program explores popular local and international finance topics in a clear and accessible manner. It also features in-depth reports on the challenges faced by different industries as they develop.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Super Trio Returns
programme.desc: The Super Trio Series is celebrating its 25th anniversary, and Super Trio Master Eric Tsang announces the shows triumphant return! Led by Chin Ka-lok, Louis Yuen, and newly joined Super Trio Masters Mayanne Mak, Ching Ho-Chun, and Ng Ka-Yee, each episode will feature a host of hilarious guest friends, participating in numerous laugh-out-loud games to deliver endless laughs and ensure the most enjoyable Sunday night for Hong Kong audiences, continuing to spread positive energy and happiness!

programme.title: Midlife, Sing Shine! 4
programme.desc: Midlife, Sing Shine! 4 has officially launched, continuing the success of the previous three seasons and once again providing a stage for singing enthusiasts to pursue their dreams. This season expands its recruitment efforts to North America and Australia, with several TVB artists participating masked, igniting the flame of music globally and illuminating the hearts of countless dreamers. Stephanie Che continues to host, offering her warm smile to the contestants Maria Cordero, Chow Kwok-fung, Cheung Ka-tim, Hai-er, and Gu Ya-wei also serve as judges, providing professional feedback and encouragement to the participants. On this new seasons stage, everyone will weave an even more moving chapter with music, continuing the heartfelt story of Midlife, Sing Shine! 4.

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: Detective vs. Sleuths
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of cold-blooded murders whose victims are runaway suspects of unsolved cases. The group of killers calls themselves The Chosen Sleuths. Former top detective Lee vows to bring the brutal killers to justice and prove himself to be the real Chosen Sleuth instead of a lunatic.

programme.title: The Kid From The Big Apple
programme.desc: Raised in the bustle of New York, Sarah is sent to Malaysia to live with her grandfather due to her mothers work. To her, it feels like falling into an unfamiliar world. In a strange neighbourhood, she hides her loneliness behind a guarded, superior attitude. Over time, however, grandfather and granddaughter grow closer, gradually opening their hearts to each other.

programme.title: Ne Zha 2
programme.desc: After surviving the Heavenly Lightning Strike, the souls of Ne Zha and Ao Bing persist, but their mortal forms lie in ruins. Master Tai Yi seeks to restore them using the Seven-Colored Lotus, yet countless perils loom over the process. As enemies close in and fate hangs in the balance, can they reclaim their bodies and rewrite their destiny?

programme.title: Wolf Hiding
programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer, Chen An vows to take revenge for her sister who was killed by a crime gang. Dealing with the police and the triad at the same time, a final battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: OMG! Moms Big News
programme.desc: 53-year-old Rita and her husband are planning retirement when she discovers shes unexpectedly pregnant, upending their quiet family life. As they prepare for the baby amid chaos and laughter, they learn profound lessons in love and acceptance. Just as peace returns, Rita learns the fetus may have Down syndrome, confronting her with the ultimate crossroads

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hong Kong
programme.desc: This is a story of ICAC investigators fighting against rampant corruption in early 1970s Hong Kong. A police sergeant teams up with a triad boss to make billions of dollars in bribes. As a lawyer joins his friend in ICAC to investigate their collusion and fight against corruption, the battle between the righteous and the wicked has just begun.

programme.title: The Lychee Road
programme.desc: A single lychee sparks a Tang Dynasty Mission Impossible! Low-ranking official Li Shan De must deliver it a thousand miles in three days to satisfy a consorts craving. Racing against time, he encounters obstacles and absurd demands, turning the journey into a satirical adventure filled with tension and unexpected twists.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperors eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Amid the recession caused by the pandemic, debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. His unconventional approach leads to unexpected success, and his attitude toward his career and life is transformed after being inspired by the respected Master Wen.

programme.title: Confinement
programme.desc: Si Ling, a pregnant painter, moves into her dream home after winning an award and hires a confinement nanny. As she begins her one-month confinement after giving birth to her daughter, inexplicable incidents start happening in the house, threatening both her and her baby

programme.title: Stuntman
programme.desc: Washed-up stunt director Li Sen is offered the role of action choreographer on his director friends final film. Bringing along an ambitious young stuntman, the two generations risk everything to stage a comeback. As Li Sen battles his fierce temper and past mistakes, he also strives to mend his relationship with his estranged daughter.

programme.title: Rob N Roll
programme.desc: A ruthless bandit, Tian, has plotted an intense and quick armed robbery. When he encounters Hui and Shui who also plan for a robbery, they decide to team up for the heist. However, their ad-hoc and dramatic robbery has started a war with the police hot on pursuit, putting their lives on the line!

programme.title: The Narrow Road
programme.desc: Chak, a small cleaning company owner, hits tough times during the pandemic. In need of an assistant, he hires a young single mother Candy, who unexpectedly helps him solve many difficulties at work. While life seems to get back on track, a series of cruel realities happen again, but they still bond together to support each other on the narrow road.

programme.title: Customs Frontline
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Customs officers uncover illegal weapons on a cargo ship linked to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover and reveal a multinational operation with ties closer to home.

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A Chinese dessert shop owned by the Chang family in Kowloon City faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. Their daughter sacrifices her dream of becoming a flight attendant to help keep the family business alive, but tensions rise as she clashes with her father. Can they find a way to overcome their struggles and remain united?

programme.title: Operation Hadal
programme.desc: An elite deep-sea special forces unit teams up with the submarine Long Jing to thwart an international super-submarine conspiracy. Facing enemy ambushes and navigating treacherous waters, they dive into a dangerous underwater battlefield, where a life-or-death showdown unfolds beneath the sea.

programme.title: Trouble Girl
programme.desc: Xiao Xiao suffers from ADHD and faces bullying in school. Her mother sees her as a troublemaker, while her father toils abroad. The only solace comes from her empathetic teacher, Paul. During a typhoon, Xiao Xiao discovers a secret between her mother and Paul, unravelling complex emotions and shared helplessness in life.

programme.title: Death Notice
programme.desc: A serial killer leaves death notices in a city, stating when, how and who he will murder. Even if the victims report it to the police and receive protection, the killer can still break through and execute them. While the police sets up a special task force in response, they expose an even bigger conspiracy behind.

programme.title: Leap
programme.desc: At the 2008 Beijing Olympics, former volleyball legend Lang Ping shocked China by coaching Team USA to victory against her home nation. Years later, when Chinas womens volleyball team fell into a slump, she returned to rebuild the squad and eventually led them to a historic gold medal triumph at the Rio 2016 Olympics.

programme.title: Article 20
programme.desc: Han Ming, a prosecutor, faces a whirlwind of complications in his work and family lives: his sons clash with another student in school and his wifes intervention, as well as the strained partnerships at work. Amidst it all, a critical case challenges his sense of righteousness, and he decides to gamble everything to seek fairness and justice.

programme.title: Project Gutenberg
programme.desc: Master counterfeiter Lee Man recounts his rise within a powerful criminal syndicate led by the mysterious Painter, whose forged banknotes are indistinguishable from real currency. As police close in, betrayal, deception, and hidden identities blur the line between truth and lies in a dangerous world of crime and manipulation.

programme.title: Once in a Blue Moon
programme.desc: Mei Zhens family appears to get along but harbours deep secrets. Mei Zhen is trapped in a dead-end job with a toxic boss, her brother hides his separation and their mother grapples with lingering guilt over her husbands departure years ago. As Mid-Autumn Festival approaches, can the family heal their wounds and find a way back to each other?

programme.title: All U Need Is Love
programme.desc: Ten major film companies join forces on a comedy-drama film to raise funds and create jobs for industry workers during the COVID-19 pandemic. This film features an all-star ensemble cast starring for free, with the story revolving around a group of hotel guests placed under quarantine in Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kams empire.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed The Invincible Fist is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Will he kill the father of his lover?

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires or fake ones!.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperors death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: Third Master is a renowned swordsman in the martial arts world, but the constant challenges by other swordsmen compel him to fake his death and pursue a secluded life. This does not prevent others from seeking him out to challenge him however, and he is forced to return to fight his way till the end.

programme.title: Lets Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fianc so as to drive away two women whom he does not like

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sisters death, but is shocked to discover that her fianc, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jins mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charns beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dongs concubine as he knows Dongs adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chus family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the groups drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummers mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Los brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hus house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hus pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: My Name Aint Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bats knife, so they try to use that to hunt the real culprit

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiaos stepmother frames her fianc Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to him. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas pursuit.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Changs. On the Changs farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: Governor Yan is killed and his guard Fan identifies Kou as the assassin by his signature weapon, a dart. Kou is listed as a wanted man when he enters the city, but managed to escape arrest with the help of the innkeepers daughter. At the same time, Fan is attacked by a bandit who pretends to be Kou. What are the secret plots behind these attacks?

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tiens gang is helping them he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: When I was Your Age
programme.desc: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that hes not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN!Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, When I was your age... Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didnt go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, When I was your age, gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?

programme.title: When I was Your Age
programme.desc: Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that hes not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN!Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, When I was your age... Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didnt go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, When I was your age, gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 政府就完善香港性罪行法例公眾諮詢剛剛結束大律師公會副主席許紹鼎接受大鳴大放專訪，表示性罪行法例有關條文五十多年未進行重大改革，與社會期望出現落差，所以香港大律師公會在諮詢期完結前，呈交了公會的建議，希望當局考慮他指出在司法制度下的重要原則是無罪推定，公會以純法律角度就這次諮詢文件提出建議，絕不會有偏重任何一方公會留意到今次性罪行法例改革的一個重要原則，是保護未成年兒童或精神缺損人士，公會同意對這些弱勢社群需要關注及留意至於今次性罪行法例改革諮詢文件沒有提及持續性侵犯兒童等相關罪行，保安局局長鄧炳強較早前表示在諮詢期間有相當意見，建議政府訂立或者引入一個持續性侵兒童的罪，局方也表示會進一步研究許紹鼎指公會就這議題大致上同意是需要引入持續性侵兒童的罪行，但考慮引入新的罪行的同時，也要加入程序上的保障，也都要確保一個舉證，一個過程的公正性公平性和被告一方的公平審訊權利；所以公會稍後有實際的建議，認為引入持續性侵兒童的罪行，具體的控罪元素和相關的一些提議的條文的相關的一些字眼，應該要審慎地考慮

programme.title: 大鳴大放
programme.desc: 總部設於香港的國際調解院在今年5月初成功處理一宗涉及內地企業與星加坡企業的海事爭議，由專理海事法的香港律師任調解員，僅在一日內達成書面和解協議國際調解院秘書長鄭若驊接受大鳴大放專訪，表示這正是一個好例子，通過調解處理海事糾紛她指出海事爭議是經常發生，過往這些爭議多是在倫敦仲裁，倫敦海事仲裁亦歷史悠久，不過近年開始有些海事爭議來亞洲仲裁今次海事爭議的個案涉及星加坡企業，當事人則選擇在香港的國際調解院處理，而非星加坡的調解中心，鄭若驊表示香港的國際調解院是有46個國家認可的一個國際組織，所以公信力和影響力更有認受性鄭若驊續指這宗海事糾紛涉及傭船契約鏈，牽涉很多不同持份者利益，能在一天成功達成調解，她建議當事人在調解前先找律師以法律角度分析爭議中的關注點，涉及的利益及限制等，她指事前功夫需做足，很多複雜案件只要各方做足準備，一至兩天內達成和解是很常見香港黃金中央清算及結算系統7月正式試營運，政府亦推出包括HAU香港黃金專屬報價等多項措施，大宗商品交易生態圈已構建，鄭若驊指涉及大宗商品交易都是國際性，她認為有需要成立一個專門的調解員名單，以處理日後涉及大宗商品交易的調解個案鄭若驊表示，希望國際調解院能夠促進和平，用調解去解決國與國之間的爭議，保持對話，避免因爭議引致不能修復的餘地

programme.title: 經緯線
programme.desc: 上月九日，狗隻進入食肆措施正式開展，不少狗主急不及待，帶毛孩到獲批食肆用餐打卡，但同時措施亦在網上掀起討論有網民指，部分狗主違反狗隻不得上餐桌或使用餐廳餐具等規定，認為是衞生隱患；有狗主就擔心，即使跟足規矩，還是會被網絡公審惡意投訴，表示很大壓力我很擔心從外面的角度拍攝，會以為狗狗已經碰到餐具，擔心餐廳會因此被投訴，甚至影響牌照，壓力有點大，吃飯未必可以完全放鬆狗主嘉文說為照顧不同客人的需要，獲批餐廳東主Raymond決定自訂規矩，包括限定午市才接待毛孩，又安排晚市前清潔；他說沒有料到，狗主不滿限制多，又惹來非狗主抨擊，揚言會不斷投訴，感歎兩面不是人措施生效以來，至少48間獲批食肆選擇退出狗隻入食肆，是否不可行呢？ 視障人士黃子倩天生只有不多於一成視力，但她熱衷去旅行，曾經遊歷十多個國家，更會拍攝影片，上載至社交平台，希望讓更多人了解視障人士的生活雖然她看不見旅途上的風景，但可以用其他感官去遊歷，她說旅行讓她成長很多，經常要解決旅程上遇到的困難，變得更勇敢，旅行對她的人生還有甚麼意義？

programme.title: 위클리 차이나우
programme.desc: 전 세계 인구 1위! GDP 2위! 국토면적 4위! 인구, 돈, 면적, 역사 등 거대한 스케일을 자랑하는 중국! 그리고 대륙 속에서 일어나는 상상 이상의 핫한 이슈들...! 지난 한 주 동안 중국에서 벌어진 뉴스들 중 문화, 경제, 사회, 역사, 연예 등 분야를 가리지 않고 현재 가장 뜨겁고 강렬한 이슈들만 골라 랭킹쇼로 풀어본다.

programme.title: 금수미앙
programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.title: YTN 24
programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.title: 대한민국을 바꾼 법의 탄생 : 헌법을 말하다
광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.title: 동시방영작여성향 게임 세계는 모브에게 가혹한 세계입니다2

programme.desc: 호빵맨은 어려움에 처한 사람이 있으면 도와주고 악당들은 혼을 내는 어린이들의 친구이자 영웅.힘없고 굶주린 사람에게는 호빵으로 만들어진 자기 얼굴을 먹게 해주지만 언제나 잼 아저씨가 새로운 빵을 구워서 얼굴을 다시 만들어 주기 때문에 걱정은 없다. 힘이 아주 세지도 않고 멋있게 생기지도 않았지만 정의롭고 순박한 성격과 정이 가는 표정이 어린이들을 한 번에 사로잡는 호빵맨만의 매력이다!
